purpose: Development-only single-trial screening before heldout inspection; not final repeated selection evidence.

manifest.warmup: one one-state fresh-process warmup per case and algorithm outside measured trials
manifest.process_policy: one measured child at a time; no parallel benchmark workers started by this harness
manifest.competing_load_note: Development: root reserved host; no concurrent tests or benchmark workers; one measured process at a time.
manifest.selection_rule: Lowest sum of complete per-case median compute time with exact candidate agreement; report overlapping ranges as uncertain.

summary.scope: Every own-turn prefix may STOP before end-turn effects. Candidates are board/resource endpoints, not mutually selectable deterministic plans or state reachability probabilities. Use conditional expansion for all legal choices and exact chance outcomes after observation.

selection.rule: Among complete equal-output methods, lowest sum of per-case median compute time; overlapping aggregate ranges are uncertain.
selection.correctness_status: Cross-method agreement only; independent oracle evidence required before recommendation.

later_changes: After these trials, fixed summary precedence so a candidate mismatch cannot be overwritten by a timing tie, and removed an unused import. Enumeration, pruning, materialization and timers unchanged. Native cleanup_ms is now attributed to the cleanup phase instead of algorithm setup; directly measured total compute timing is unchanged.
